240-5223-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-5223-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-1594-2921-5131--202.description:

Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1110-4694-7839--112.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
1110-4694-7839--112.description:
Deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
When the Treasure(s) enter as creature(s) due to March of the Machines, Terror of the Peaks triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to Smaug.
Repeat from step 2.
1110-4694-7839--112.notes: The anthem effect must boost the power and toughness of artifact creatures you control by 1 or more. While you will get infinite Treasures, because they are creatures, you cannot activate them right away unless you give them haste. If the anthem boosts power by 2 or more, you can get additional Terror of the Peaks triggers to deal infinite damage.

2292-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Viscera Seer by paying its mana cost.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-4871-6797-6887.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-6797-6887.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-1734-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6151.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Underdark Explorer from exile to the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

1368-4068-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one Mountain.
1368-4068-6321-6723.description:

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2034-4094-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4094-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-3322-4927-5702.easyPrerequisites:

You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3322-4927-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-5220-6273-6900.notablePrerequisites:

2292-5220-6273-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

2843-6553-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.

Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

790-3862-4651.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.

Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.

Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

3259-5223--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2440-2534-3263-4183.description:

372-695-2187.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.

Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.

Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Repeat.

There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.

Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1365-1537-4050-4751.notablePrerequisites: Zealous Conscripts and Verduous Gearhulk do not have a -1/-1 counter on them.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, adding one mana of any color.
When Zealous Conscripts dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk, adding one mana of any color.
When Verdurous Gearhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Zealous Conscripts, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Repeat.

Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

4872-5021-5261.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Noxious Revival without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Noxious Revival, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
